name: Khatmi Seeds
description:
Buy Khatmi Seeds

Khatmi Seeds has been used for over 2,000 years as both a food and a medicine. The roots and leaves of the marshmallow plant are used medicinally to treat coughs and sore throats. Marshmallow’s high mucilage content soothes inflamed mucous membranes. It has also been used to soothe chapped skin, chilblains (sores caused by exposure to cold), and minor wounds.
